criteria.guidance: A fire extinguisher body is visible at the marked station. An empty bracket or missing unit is DEFECT.
Nothing is stored in front of or blocking access to the extinguisher in the visible frames.
An inspection tag is visible on the body. Report a literally readable due date via the label block; an unreadable tag stays UNKNOWN.
A first-aid notice or marking is posted and visible near the station.
A first-aid box with green-cross marking is present. Contents and expiry cannot be judged from outside; that stays UNKNOWN.
A green escape-route sign is visible and oriented so it can be followed.
The visible route below the sign is unobstructed. Judge only the area actually shown in the frames.
Every visible person wears a safety helmet. Any bare-headed person on site is DEFECT; no visible persons is N_A only when caller-verified, otherwise UNKNOWN.
Every visible person wears a high-visibility vest. Any person without one is DEFECT.
